title: Wildmark Library: 8 Fantasy Hero Sprite Packs, Every New One
short_text: 8 fantasy hero sprite packs in one download, every new Wildmark pack added free
description:
8 Wildmark fantasy hero sprite packs in one download: 14 heroes, 50 held items, 3 action sets, MZ battlers, Godot 4 and RPG Maker MZ files, $61.92 one by one. Royalty free in commercial games, no credit required. This page is $14.99. The CSAF Sprite Library ($19.99) includes this family and every other CSAF sprite pack.

Buy once, keep every Wildmark pack that joins.

How the future packs work

  • When a new Wildmark pack comes out, its files are added to this page on launch day.
  • You do not pay again. Open your itch.io library and the new files are there.
  • Every addition gets a devlog post here, so follow the page to hear about it.

Latest additions

  • 2026-11-12: Handheld 01 joins with 50 held weapons and tools drawn into the hands of the 4 Wildmark 01 heroes, on every idle and walk frame in all four facings. New here first: it has no page of its own yet.
  • 2026-11-07: the three pack Wildmark Collection becomes the Wildmark Library, 7 packs and 4,956 PNG frames and sheets.

What's inside (8 packs)

The hero casts: Wildmark 01, 03 and 04 (3 packs, $17.97 one by one): Wildmark 01: The Party, 128x128 & 64x64 hero character sprites; Wildmark 03: The Far Kin, 128x128 & 64x64 character sprites; Wildmark 04: Dragonkin, 128x128 & 64x64 character sprites.

Held weapons and tools for the Wildmark 01 heroes: Handheld 01 (1 pack, $8.99 one by one): Handheld 01: 50 held weapons and tools for the Wildmark party [128x128 & 64x64] (new here first, no page of its own yet).

Extra action sets for the heroes: Wildmark Actions 02 to 04 (3 packs, $27.97 one by one): Wildmark Actions 02: Four Facings, strike, hurt, death & cast, 128x128 & 64x64 sprites; Wildmark Actions 03: Everyday Verbs, pick up, interact, knockdown & get up, 128x128 & 64x64 sprites; Wildmark Actions 04: Roll and Guard, dodge roll & block sprites, 4 directions, 128x128 & 64x64.

Wildmark Battlers: the heroes as RPG Maker MZ side-view actors (1 pack, $6.99 one by one): Wildmark Battlers: Side-View Sprites for RPG Maker MZ.

Held back from this build while a repair ships, then added free: Wildmark 02: The Second Rank, 128x128 RPG Character Sprites and Wildmark Actions 01: Strike, Hurt, Death, 128x128 & 64x64 action sprites. Both are still sold on their own pages meanwhile.

What a pack contains

Every pack sits in its own folder exactly as its own page delivers it (Handheld 01: the package its own page will carry): PNG frames and sheets at 64x64 and 128x128, a frames.json map, Godot 4 SpriteFrames, its own Readme and its own licence. Wildmark 01, Wildmark 03 and Wildmark 04 are hero casts (14 heroes) with idle and walk in four directions. Handheld 01 draws 50 held weapons and tools into the hands of the 4 Wildmark 01 heroes as overlay sheets laid out cell for cell like theirs, and every item also ships alone in its own cell. Wildmark Actions 02 adds strike, hurt, death and cast; Wildmark Actions 03 adds pick up, interact, knockdown and get up; Wildmark Actions 04 adds dodge roll and guard. All 3 action sets animate the Wildmark 01 party, and Wildmark Actions 02 also animates the 4 heroes of Wildmark 02. Wildmark Battlers turns 8 heroes into RPG Maker MZ side-view actors with all 18 battle motions. 4 packs carry RPG Maker MZ sheets; every pack works in any engine that reads PNG, including Unity and GameMaker. CATALOGUE.md lists every folder and its page.

Licence

You can use the sprites in commercial and personal games, as many projects as you like, with no royalty and no credit required, and edit them freely. You can't resell or share the sprites themselves as an asset pack, or use them to train a model. Each pack's own LICENSE.txt governs its folder.

The art in all 8 packs is generated with an AI pixel art model (PixelLab, on a paid plan that grants commercial use), then palette locked and checked by our own tooling. The tooling was written with AI assistance.

Try before you buy

Free heroes from the same family: Wildmark Sampler: 4 Free Fantasy Hero Sprites [128 & 64 px].

Questions or a hero you want next: post a comment below, or on the Request Desk. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.

$14.99. Buyers keep every Wildmark pack that joins.

devlog.title: Wildmark Library: Handheld 01 added, 8 packs now
devlog.html:
Handheld 01 joins the Wildmark Library today: 50 held weapons and tools for the 4 Wildmark 01 heroes. If you own this page it is already in your download, free. Open your itch.io library or let the itch app update it.

  • 50 items in 7 groups: blades 7, axes and blunt 8, ranged 6, polearms and staves 7, magic 3, tools 13, light and carried 6.
  • Drawn into the hands of elf, warrior, mage, rogue on every idle and walk frame, in all four facings, at 128x128 and 64x64.
  • Overlay sheets laid out cell for cell like the Wildmark 01 sheets, so an item sits on top of the body with no offsets to work out. Every item also ships alone in its own cell.
  • 12,902 PNG files, Godot 4 SpriteFrames for every hero and item, its own Readme and licence, in the folder held-items/handheld-equipment-overlay/.

Handheld 01 is new here first: it has no page of its own yet, so this page and the CSAF Sprite Library are the only places to get it for now.

The Library now holds 8 Wildmark packs for $14.99, worth $61.92 bought one by one. 2 more join the day their repairs ship. Every new Wildmark pack joins on its launch day, with a post here, so follow the page to hear about it. The CSAF Sprite Library ($19.99) holds this family and every other CSAF sprite pack.

The art is generated with an AI pixel art model (PixelLab, paid plan) and checked by our own tooling. Free Wildmark heroes to try first: wildmark-sampler. Questions or a hero you want next: leave a comment. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support it.
